note: Only the narrow side panel was photographed — the front was not. Nutrition recorded is the NEW ZEALAND/AUSTRALIA panel, for 30 g popped corn ready to eat. The same panel also carries a separate SOUTH AFRICA panel with different figures (per 100 g: 1996 kJ, protein 9.7 g, glycaemic carbohydrate 65 g, total sugar 0.8 g, total fat 19.5 g, saturated 8.9 g, fibre 12.2 g, sodium 800 mg) and a different ingredient list ('INGREDIENTS: POPPING CORN, VEGETABLE OIL [(PALM FRUIT) (TBHQ AND ACIDITY REGULATOR)], SALT, FLAVOURING, COLOURANT. CONTAINS: MILK.'). Barcode not in frame.
